name: fraction_role
description: Name whether a specified integer in a fraction is its numerator or denominator; control classifies the same specified integer as even/odd.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 a,b=random.sample(range(2,40),2);role=i%2; x=[a,b][role]
 text=f'Fraction: {a}/{b}. Consider the number {x}.'
 items.append({'prompt':text+' Is it the numerator or denominator? Answer:', 'answer':' '+['numerator','denominator'][role]})
 control.append({'prompt':text+' Is it even or odd? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('even' if x%2==0 else 'odd')})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
